label: Gigaset N870 IP PRO
description: Gigaset N870 IP PRO, one hardware design that becomes DECT base, DECT manager or integrator by licence, scaling from 60 bases/250 handsets to 6,000 bases/20,000 handsets with a virtual integrator and seamless handover. Provisioned by zero-touch autoconfig over a single 10/100 RJ45 that doubles as its 802.3af class-1 power feed.
notes: Gigaset product page specification table: 'LAN Port with Power-over-Ethernet: Yes', 'Power connector: Yes' - exactly one LAN jack, no passthrough. Line rate and power class come from the N870 IP PRO datasheet hardware section: 'Ethernet RJ45 10/100 Mbps', 'Power over Ethernet: PoE IEEE 802.3af class 1', draw '< 3.8 W'. 3.84 W is the class-1 reservation. DECT GAP/CAT-iq 1.0, 120 channels, 50 m indoor / 300 m outdoor, up to 10 simultaneous G.711 calls per base (5 wideband), SIP+TLS/SRTP, DHCP options 1/3/6/12/15/28/42/114/120, 802.1Q, uaCSTA, xHTML. DECT radio not modelled as an interface.
